fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: Results for each topic we tried to create.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: TopicConfigErrorCode
fields.about: Optional topic config error returned if configs are not returned in the response.

fields.name: NumPartitions
fields.about: Number of partitions of the topic.

fields.name: ReadOnly
fields.about: True if the configuration is read-only.

fields.name: IsSensitive
fields.about: True if this configuration is sensitive.
